meta_description: Edge2Edge Garden Maintenance in Manchester offers professional garden upkeep, landscaping, and seasonal care. Expert local gardener serving Failsworth and surrounding areas.
hero_subhead: Professional garden care tailored to your home. From overgrown borders to seasonal upkeep, we bring your outdoor space back to life.
services_subhead: Everything your garden needs — from weekly cuts to complete landscape overhauls and seasonal maintenance.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, hedge trimming, and border upkeep keep your garden looking sharp year-round. We work around your schedule.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your space. We clear dense weeds, remove dead trees and shrubs, and dispose of all waste responsibly.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: Aeration, scarification, and targeted treatments restore patchy lawns to lush green. Includes seasonal feeding and moss control.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Work
services.desc: Expert pruning, shaping, and removal of all sizes. We keep hedges in shape and improve sight lines safely.

services.title: Seasonal Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Spring deep cleans, autumn leaf clearance, and winter preparation keep your garden season-ready without the hassle.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: New patios, planting schemes, and raised beds bring your vision to life. We advise on plants suited to your soil and sunlight.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love helping neighbours reclaim their outdoor spaces.
about_para_1: Edge2Edge Garden Maintenance was founded on the belief that every garden deserves proper care, regardless of size or condition. For over 12 years, we've served Failsworth, Droylsden, and surrounding Manchester areas with reliable, straightforward garden work—from routine cuts to complete garden transformations. We're a tight-knit local team who take pride in showing up on time, doing the job right, and leaving your garden better than we found it.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen to what they want and deliver without fuss or hidden charges. We've built our reputation on treating every garden with care and keeping the experience stress-free. Whether you need a one-off tidy or year-round maintenance, we've got the expertise and equipment to handle it properly.

reviews.text: Had a complete nightmare with our garden—three years of neglect and ivy everywhere. Edge2Edge cleared it all, disposed of everything, and suggested a proper planting plan. Best decision we made. Fair price and no messing about.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: They've been doing our garden every two weeks for two years now. Always on time, tidy workers, and they remember what we talked about last visit. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sandra H.

reviews.text: Brilliant lads. Came round for an overgrown hedge, ended up doing the whole front. Sorted it in a day, cleared all the mess, and the quote matched the invoice. No surprises.
reviews.author: David P.
